title: Versioned immutable execution-authority snapshot — CANDIDATE v0.1.0 (not frozen, not active, grants nothing)
description: PR363 §7.4 step-2 candidate. One minimal shape for a versioned immutable authority snapshot. Field names, grammars and semantics of the six current_contract fields are carried over UNCHANGED from scripts/ci-pr-gate.mjs checkCurrentContract at fixed master 4aaaa7b2af87f80a0fae62d9c8d9cf03d5a6fd84 (Q2 grammar :325-330, Q4 baseline :333-336); this schema validates SHAPE only. Every external reality check the legacy block gets today must keep running against the snapshot after any switch: active_plan/backlog/matrix target existence (Q2 fileExists), baseline resolves AND is HEAD-or-ancestor (Q4 revExists/baselineCurrent — git object reality, never a copy), backlog BL-/BR id population (GROUP C ci-pr-gate.mjs:351-356), matrix row contract (Q5 :372-406), phase-baseline-ref lines (Q6 :485-492), and the second independent awk reader at .github/workflows/census-runtime.yml:129. Those are publisher/CI duties, not schema duties; dropping any of them at switch time is a regression, not a simplification.

not: not frozen; freezing happens only after the one merged root review (§7.4 step 2 completion is a decision, not this file)
not active; no consumer reads this shape today and no authority is decided by it
not a new permission law; it authorizes no write of any kind (ERRATA-20261025 E1)
not ratification; the 18 IDs remain proposed (0 ratified)
x-status.digest_algorithm_reused: content_digest is computed with the EXISTING F0 canonical rules (dev/agent-workflow/evidence/s1-f0-issued-20261025/F0-ISSUED-20261025.json canonical_digest_algorithm: UTF-8 no BOM, keys sorted by code point recursively, arrays order-preserved, compact separators, raw non-ASCII, zero 0x0A, sha256 lowercase hex prefixed sha256:) over the snapshot object with the content_digest key itself removed. No new digest law is invented here.

snapshot_version.description: Explicit version id (asYYYYMMDDrN). Unique per publication; a published version is never rewritten (immutability is a publisher rule — the schema can only name it).

supersedes.description: The single immediately-preceding version, or null for the first. One linear chain; forks mean two publishers, which the publisher contract forbids.

authored_from.description: Unique source of the values, recorded as one pointer: either the legacy block at a named commit, or a prior snapshot at a named commit. Naming the commit is what makes the provenance checkable later.

published_by.description: The single registered publisher identity that produced this snapshot (see PUBLISHER-CONTRACT.md §sole-publisher). One identity, named, no anonymous or shared bulk accounts.

published_utc.description: Publication wall-clock. Unlike baseline_collected this is snapshot metadata, deliberately OUTSIDE any digested inputs object if a future F-style gate hashes this file.

current_phase_statement.description: OPTIONAL carrier for the adjacent live statement graph.yaml:64 current_phase. NOT a seventh current_contract field and NOT a synonym of phase_id: its graded relationship to phase_id is a digit-agreement check (ci-pr-gate.mjs:343-345: pm=/^alpha(\d+)/i.exec(phase_id); the statement must contain ALPHA\.?<N>) plus the Alpha.4 ban (:343) and the state-freshness bans (:186-195: must not embed a revision, must not enumerate PR numbers). The digit cross-check is cross-field and therefore a publisher-side check, not expressible in this draft-07 shape; the two machine-bannable shapes are pinned below. Whether current_phase is retired or restated at switch time is §7.4 step-6 adjudication (AUTHORITY-MIGRATION-MAP adjacent_live_statement), still open.

current_contract.description: Exactly the six fields, same names, same original semantics (AUTHORITY-MIGRATION-MAP old_current_contract_fields). No additions: an unknown seventh key is exactly the silent drift Q3 counts against today.

phase_id.description: Grammar copied verbatim from ci-pr-gate.mjs:326. Sole downstream machine consumer of its value today is doc-checks checkPlanCitationBlocks via the derived mirror (MACHINE-CONSUMERS MC-04).

active_plan.description: Prefix check per Q2 (:328-330); target existence is a publisher/CI duty.

backlog.description: A single non-space path. Not a leaf pointer: its content authorises graph ready:/blocked: BL-/BR ids (GROUP C ci-pr-gate.mjs:351-356) and Q6 re-reads its phase-baseline-ref line (:485-492); the content contract travels with the value.

matrix.description: A single non-space path. Not a leaf pointer: Q5 grades the file itself (boundary markers, region order, 9-cell rows, positive-claim set, ci-pr-gate.mjs:372-406).

baseline.description: Exactly 40 hex per Q4 (:333). The value's MEANING lives in git object reality (must resolve; HEAD or ancestor; equality with HEAD legal) — the snapshot records the string, git decides it. census-runtime.yml:129 is a second independent reader and must be repointed in any switch transaction.

baseline_collected.description: ISO8601Z per Q2 (:330). Timestamp only; no external corroboration exists (MIGRATION-MAP field note).

content_digest.description: The authority digest every parallel Agent must explicitly bind to during the switch window (§7.4 fixed order, last sentence). Computed per x-status.digest_algorithm_reused over this object with content_digest itself removed.

x-current-phase-bans.note: If current_phase_statement is present, the publisher additionally refuses (machine shape; the wording rules are Q1/state-freshness, cited in the property above):
bans: an embedded revision: /\b[0-9a-f]{7,40}\b/ inside the statement (state-freshness leg, ci-pr-gate.mjs:192)
a PR census: /PR\s*#?\d/ inside the statement (state-freshness leg, ci-pr-gate.mjs:195)
